cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el saldo neto del elemento contable 1 en enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS saldo FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN accounting_account aa ON aa.id = jed.account_id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND aa.code LIKE '1%' AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-02-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS saldo_neto FROM public.journal_entry_detail AS jed JOIN public.journal_entry AS je ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN public.accounting_account AS aa ON jed.account_id = aa.id WHERE (aa.id = 1 AND je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto sumaron el debe y el haber por tipo de cuenta en enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT aa.type, SUM(jed.debit) AS total_debe, SUM(jed.credit) AS total_haber FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN accounting_account aa ON aa.id = jed.account_id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-02-01' GROUP BY aa.type ORDER BY aa.type LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT aa.type AS tipo_cuenta, COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) AS total_debe, COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS total_haber FROM public.journal_entry_detail AS jed JOIN public.journal_entry AS je ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN public.accounting_account AS aa ON jed.account_id = aa.id WHERE (je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE GROUP BY aa.type LIMIT 50
